entries.embedded_english: Hurry up with that damned bunker!
Move in, let's finish this now.
Carson! Where's that flamethrower?
Trench is secure, Sarge!
Get back and take that bunker dammit!
Get down the tunnel and secure that bunker!
Bunker secured, Sarge!  Miller did good again.
They've got a bazooka!
Sarge, they're dug into a pair of bunkers. Looks like some kinda old tomb buildings.
Hell!
Get down! Use the Sherman as cover!
We're gonna take that ridge, clearing every trench and every bunker as we go.
Can't see 'em.  Maybe they turned tail and ran for it.
You want another movie set, Polonsky?  How about  a genuine Japanese medieval fortress...
Sarge, they're coming!
Inside, guys! Let's smoke 'em out!
Woodpecker!
Enemy ahead Sarge! Damn - they're crawling out of the woodwork!
You want to get your head blown off?  Stay in cover behind the tank!
We've made it to the top!
Listen up.   We get through this, and we'll have broken through their defense line.  We move on the right hand bunker first, take the perimeter wall then go in for the kill.   Everyone ready?
They musta gone sight seeing, Sarge.
So this is the Shuri Line, huh?
Fine work, men.   The Japanese defense line is split in two.  They'll have to pull back or be overrun by our advance.
Next stop Tokyo.  Right, Captain?
The road's open, Polonsky, but we're not at the end of the line just yet.
Sarge! Here comes our Sherman!
Sergeant, I want that bunker out of action.
They're dug in at each end of the trench, Sarge!
Woodpecker MG! It's covering the whole approach.
Enemy on the left bank!
Nail that guy! Keep him off the tank!
Move up!
It ain't over yet, Marine.
Let's go men! Move move move!
Yeah, Polonsky. This stands between us and the last Japanese position on the island.
Bunkers, mortars - they're dug in real good.
Our armored support.  And about time.
Bunker secure.  This place is ours!
Alright, move up and keep your heads down!
Spread out and clear those caves!
Work round to the left and get into the bunker tunnel.
Mortars knocked out, Sarge!
Bunker cleared!
Man, it's like something outta a Tarzan movie!
Here they come, Sarge!
Use the Sherman as mobile cover, damnit.  That's what armored support's for!
Keep to the riverbed and watch out for the enemy.
